extracted.intended_audience: newsrooms, editors, journalists, media organisations (including sports publishers)
extracted.subtask_description: Product/feature guidance for using editorial analytics and AI-driven tools to inform newsroom decisions (headlines, story selection, audience targeting), including a sport-specific 'User Needs for Sports' model.

rubrics_metrics.name: User Needs for Sports Model
rubrics_metrics.description: Help sports publishers everywhere create stories that are genuinely valuable for a clearly defined audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sport coverage is different from regular journalism. As news production has been optimised through user needs for news, sports content can also be optimised but requires a sport-specific focus. (Smartocto and Dmitry Shishkin teamed up to build this model.)

rubrics_metrics.name: reports
rubrics_metrics.description: the information you need, when you need it
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide timely, targeted reports that surface the key information editors and journalists require to make editorial decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: dashboards
rubrics_metrics.description: customisable big screens to keep you sharp
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customisable dashboards/visualisations for monitoring performance and keeping teams aware of important metrics in real time.

rubrics_metrics.name: smart notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: tips and suggestions suited to your workflow
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextual, workflow-integrated notifications that surface editorial tips and suggestions when they are relevant to the user's tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: A/B testing
rubrics_metrics.description: tests to show which headlines, intros or images work best
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run controlled experiments on elements such as headlines, lead paragraphs, and images to empirically determine which variants drive better engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: quadrant model
rubrics_metrics.description: smart visualisations showing which stories work for your audience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visual quadrant-style models to map and compare story performance and audience fit, helping editors prioritise and plan coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: user needs tagger
rubrics_metrics.description: automated content classification for historical data sets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automatically tag content by user need to enable analysis over historical archives and to inform future editorial decisions based on audience needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI overlay
rubrics_metrics.description: super smart content editing suggestions in any browser
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An AI-driven overlay that provides in-browser content-editing suggestions to improve articles, headlines, or other copy directly within editorial workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions (AI agent)
rubrics_metrics.description: smart agent designed to support editing decisions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An AI-powered assistant intended to help editors make data-informed choices about coverage, prioritisation, and optimisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: video analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: reports to show engagement and where traffic originates from
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analytics focused on video content to understand viewer engagement and referral/traffic sources, informing distribution and production strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: CMS integration (WoodWing Studio integration)
rubrics_metrics.description: realtime insights and automated tips available directly inside WoodWing Studio
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integration eliminates the need to switch between tools by surfacing editorial analytics and automated tips within the CMS, reducing workflow friction.
